# ConverterDrivenStability

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Stability analysis focused on power electronic converters as the primary dynamic agents, rather than traditional synchronous machines. Relevant for TCC/iNEST because converter-dominated grids resemble heterogeneous networks with fast local dynamics, similar to neuromorphic cores.
